name: NCBI RefSeq PGAP CDS annotation
software: NCBI RefSeq annotated assembly distribution (no local PGAP re-run; no eggNOG-mapper)
gff_source: NCBI RefSeq/PGAP genomic GFF shipped with the exact same GCF assembly version as the selected M60 case
retrieval_method: HTTPS GET of <ftp_path>/<assembly_directory_basename>_genomic.gff.gz from the case ftp_path recorded in M60_COHORT_MANIFEST.json. Fallback: same directory <basename>_feature_table.txt.gz. No later reannotation of the same organism is substituted.
assembly_accession_matching_rule: The GCF accession in the URL path, the GFF/feature-table filename prefix, and the M60 case accession must be identical strings (including version suffix). A different GCF version is a comparator failure, not a substitution.

parser.name: m60_pgap_gff_v1_frozen_protocol_v1_1
parser.language: Python 3 stdlib (gzip, urllib). No BioPython. No manual interpretation.

binary_conversion_rule.POSITIVE: The frozen PGAP annotation identifies the corresponding rpoB / DNA-directed RNA polymerase beta-subunit locus according to the pre-registered rule: any CDS has gene exactly rpoB (case-insensitive) OR product matches RNA polymerase subunit beta / rpoB naming (product contains 'rna polymerase' AND 'beta' AND NOT 'beta prime' AND NOT "beta'" AND NOT 'rpoC' AND NOT 'beta-prime').
binary_conversion_rule.NEGATIVE: Annotation file is present and parseable and has zero rpoB hits under that rule.
binary_conversion_rule.UNCERTAIN: GFF/feature table missing, unreadable, or has no CDS features.
binary_conversion_rule.rpoC_exclusion: A CDS with gene=rpoC or a product naming RNA polymerase beta-prime / rpoC is not an rpoB POSITIVE.
